scorePolicy: Strongest query relevance with minimum score 0.35 and margin 0.03; otherwise gray. Heuristic point coloring, not validated object segmentation.
limitations: Reduced-detail pilot; building and road queries failed image-patch validation. Individual point labels and objects are unvalidated. Color regions are not object instances.
placement: Exact original XYZ, scale, rotation and opacity; degree-zero class colors replace appearance only. Mounted under the same modelRoot as the full-detail normal view. No camera or geographic transform change.
